layout.assumptions: Measured road envelope 3.15 by 2.07 m; both lanes are 0.285 m wide and clockwise. Inner lane centre radius 0.4625 m; the default radius is estimated from the image. Parking dimensions and positions, vehicle and camera values are provisional. Symmetric front/rear overhang is assumed; the rear-axle initial pose places the front bumper on the start line. Parking bays move in x to stay inside the road loop as the radius changes.
